tests.doc: The behaviour behind BUG-001: drop the hammer, let the pile despawn (300 ticks), ask Bram again.
The first three messages are always Welcome, Catalog, MapData, in that order.
After the map and its entities come the player's own state, then the tutorial objective.
Examine is on every entity's action list (the client's right-click always has it).
The strict decoder (length prefix exact, no trailing bytes) accepted everything the server sent.
D-022 hand of 5, D-024 energy held at 2. Six cards in the deck, so one is left to draw.
D-153: you can see what's in your draw pile, sorted, so its order gives nothing away.
A Craft for a forge recipe with no forge nearby gets a warning, not an item.
Three parallel arrays: one entry per recipe in each, and a reason only when it can't be made.
D-076: shafts, heads and feathers converge at the bench. All 45 inputs are spent for 15 arrows.
D-103: hidden intents. Only counts are sent for the enemy, never its cards.
Two cards costing 2 each (pickaxe, axe) need 4 energy; you have 2.
D-075: plucking is non-lethal. Fifteen feathers per pluck, and the chicken stays.
